design: Soft 3D folded white paper with pale-blue edges and cobalt functional symbols, transparent background.

delivery.normalization: Determine content bounds from alpha > 32 to ignore negligible background noise, preserve an 8px source margin and the generated alpha within the crop, then fit each icon in a 156px box centered on a transparent 192px canvas. Lanczos resampling and lossless PNG optimization only.

style_reference: The generated blank page master was used as the style reference for the other icons.
